en.headline: Two private cars collide inside Tate's Cairn Tunnel, one driver injured
en.dek: The early-morning crash on the northbound carriageway caused temporary congestion; one driver sustained minor injuries.
body: Two private cars collided inside Tate's Cairn Tunnel early on Tuesday, leaving one driver with minor injuries.

The accident occurred around 3 a.m. as one vehicle was heading towards Sha Tin and struck another car inside the tunnel. Images from the scene showed significant front-end damage to one of the vehicles.
Traffic in the tunnel was temporarily congested following the incident. Police are investigating the circumstances of the crash.

zh.headline: 大老山隧道兩私家車相撞 一司機輕傷
zh.dek: 今晨約3時北行線發生車禍，其中一輛車車頭嚴重損毀，隧道一度擠塞。
body: 今晨約3時，大老山隧道內兩輛私家車相撞，一名司機輕傷。
事發時一輛私家車正往沙田方向行駛，在隧道內與另一車輛相撞。現場照片顯示其中一輛車車頭損毀嚴重。
意外後隧道交通一度擠塞。警方正調查意外原因。
